This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P2, which must be 
 carried out from four to six years as indicated by Y4:6 in the 
 title block.

This first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Migid Aly, tested by eng. Sayed 
 El-Ashry, revised by eng. Adel Abdel Qader El Nagar EDEPC inspection 
 quality control, approved by eng. Mohamed Abd El-Ghaffar Al Aresh PS general 
 director.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS Coordinator and certified 
 by accountant Mahmoud Soliman, EDEPC General director of admin, 
 financial inspection and supervisor of inspection and quality control head 
 sector.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

items:
Work order must be issued before start work and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes, safety clothes and breathing mask when 
 cleaning. ... etc,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
The generator in case of shut down.
The circuit breaker of generator on test position.
Put ground on the generator windings.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.
Safety helmet, safety belt, safety shoes and complete tools
Special tools for extracting the rotor.
Voltage indicator, portable earth for discharging.
Blower and brushes.
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes.
DC 1000 V megger.

Measure the insulation resistance
 More than 12 MΩ
Check of silicon rectifiers
Check of bearing metal
Check and adjustment of alignment
Check and cleaning of stator coil end
Check and cleaning of exciter
Check and cleaning rotor
Check and cleaning earth brush
Check of brush holder spring pressure
Check and clean the air coolers
Additional tightening of foundation bolts
UT. Inspection of retaining rings

Check and adjustment of main terminal bolts 
 connection

Check and adjustment of aux. wiring terminal 
 bolts connection
Alarm test
Cleaning of cooling water piping
Check and adjust the clearance at each section
UT. Inspection of rotor wedges
Looseness check of set screws for rotor wedges
Pressure test of air coolers

Check or repair of air cooler headers inner 
 coating
Check or replacement of earthing brushes
Check or replacement of seal strips for bearing
Replacement of packing foe air coolers
Check and looseness of stator wedges and end winding portions
Replacement of consumable parts
Disconnect the ground on the generator winding
Put the circuit breaker of the generator on service position
Lift up the safety fence with caution mark surrounding the work area

Finish the work permit with coordination with shift 
 engineer.

Introduction
This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P2, which must be 
 carried out from four to six years as indicated by Y4:6 in the 
 title block.
Technical Data
This first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Migid Aly, tested by eng. Sayed 
 El-Ashry, revised by eng. Adel Abdel Qader El Nagar EDEPC inspection 
 quality control, approved by eng. Mohamed Abd El-Ghaffar Al Aresh PS general 
 director.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS Coordinator and certified 
 by accountant Mahmoud Soliman, EDEPC General director of admin, 
 financial inspection and supervisor of inspection and quality control head 
 sector.
Safety Precautions
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Work order must be issued before start work and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes, safety clothes and breathing mask when 
 cleaning. ... etc,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
The generator in case of shut down.
The circuit breaker of generator on test position.
Put ground on the generator windings.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, safety belt, safety shoes and complete tools
Special tools for extracting the rotor.
Voltage indicator, portable earth for discharging.
Blower and brushes.
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes.
DC 1000 V megger.
Work to be Carried out
Measure the insulation resistance
 More than 12 MΩ
Check of silicon rectifiers
Check of bearing metal
Check and adjustment of alignment
Check and cleaning of stator coil end
Check and cleaning of exciter
Check and cleaning rotor
Check and cleaning earth brush
Check of brush holder spring pressure
Check and clean the air coolers
Additional tightening of foundation bolts
UT. Inspection of retaining rings
Check and adjustment of main terminal bolts 
 connection
Check and adjustment of aux. wiring terminal 
 bolts connection
Alarm test
Cleaning of cooling water piping
Check and adjust the clearance at each section
UT. Inspection of rotor wedges
Looseness check of set screws for rotor wedges
Pressure test of air coolers
Check or repair of air cooler headers inner 
 coating
Check or replacement of earthing brushes
Check or replacement of seal strips for bearing
Replacement of packing foe air coolers
Check and looseness of stator wedges and end winding portions
Replacement of consumable parts
Return the Equipment into 
Service
Disconnect the ground on the generator winding
Put the circuit breaker of the generator on service position
Lift up the safety fence with caution mark surrounding the work area
Finish the work permit with coordination with shift 
 engineer.
